author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
GLM is cheapest tokens available for personal use, so I joined z.ai for a month and see how it is. 

Subjective experience is so far so good, it is better than Sonnet but worse than Opus. I am using Cline for interactive work and Opencode for agentic work with GLM.

shared_article.title: Z.ai - Advanced AI Chatbot & Agent powered by GLM-5.3-Flash
